hotels.title: Stylish Sri Lanka Beachfront Escape in Bentota with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Dinner
hotels.description: Wake every morning to the sound of waves lapping Bentota Beach at EKHO Surf, where sunlight spills into every corner. Expect barefoot ease, whether you're unwinding by the pool or walking straight onto the sand from the garden. A pool sits steps from the beach, while L'héritage serves all-day dining with views across the water. At sunset, head to Tuna Turner - the property's own seafood restaurant and beach bar - for fresh seafood and drinks by the water. EKHO Surf makes it easy to embrace the coastal mood. Grab a kayak, head out for a morning jet ski session, or take a short trip five minutes down the road to bustling Aluthgama for local restaurants and markets. In the evening, head inland to enjoy the gardens at Brief Garden by Bevis Bawa, less than 20 minutes from your door, before returning to your spot by the sea.
